verdict.rationale: Termius is a cross-platform SSH client with mobile apps. A buyer could reasonably ask whether such a tool manages remote coding agents, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no first-party feature for launching, managing or tracking cloud coding-agent tasks. Its only AI feature is converting plain-language descriptions into shell commands, and SSH-ing from a phone to a server running an agent would be a user-side workaround, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage and track cloud-based coding agent tasks from my phone
